text: The purpose of this report is to request approval to amend the existing contract Number 47022988, issued to Ecotex Healthcare Linen Services LLP ("Ecotex") as a result of the City-wide Request for Proposal Number 0105-19-0127 Doc2101183619, for the provision of linen laundering services by a total amount of $726,251 (excluding all taxes and charges) or $739,033 (net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries) for the period up to and including the separate, optional one-year renewals, to the expiry date ending February 28, 2025. This City-wide call was awarded as separate contracts to Senior Services and Long-Term Care, Children's Services and Toronto Paramedic Services. Currently, most linen used by Paramedics in the course of patient care is deposited at hospitals for pick-up and laundering by the various hospitals' contracted vendors. In many cases, the hospital vendor is Ecotex.…

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71-11.1.C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 71 (Financial Control), authorized the Chief Procurement Officer to amend Toronto Paramedic Services' contract for the provision of linen laundering services, by an additional amount of $726,251 excluding all taxes and charges ($739,033 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries), increasing the current City-wide value from $9,246,668 to $9,972,920 excluding all taxes and charges ($9,409,410 to $10,148,443 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries).
